title: Latest (after 17.12) nightly Builds (automatic) have a broken watchface
body:
The nightly Builds after 17.12 have a broken Watchface.
On the SmartWatch, the xDrip-Watchface is only Black and show nothing :-(

comments.body:
@kskandispersonal are you able to check this? thanks

@diabetesdt1 Can you use System Status menu in xDrip app to confirm exactly the version you are currently running?
@jamorham I do not see this is yesterday's code built on my machine.  I just pulled the latest code and will rebuild, test and report back.

Version 1612171610 works
with the latest Version 161220800 from today morning it works, but only when the watch is not rebootet.

When  have choose a other Watchface and then the xDrip Watchface again, it works.


From a Watch reboot and xDrip default Watchface is active (default sw3 not rooted, latest android-wear system updates are installed, Wear 1.5.0.3044569, Android 6.0.1, Security-Patches: 05.07.2016):

Please try this version and let me know if it resolves the problem:

Yes, it works. 
The Watchface/xdrip-prefs not crashed after installing and reboot (phone and watch; watch only).

Thank you very much!

@jamorham it is the same account. Only for forks of diabetes-software from me :-) sorry, i used the false login (blocklist.de). issue is solved. Thanks!
